content.short: Printr is a universal token launchpad for creating and trading tokens across multiple blockchains.
content.description: Printr is a token launchpad built around cross-chain token creation, trading, and liquidity management. The protocol uses modular smart contracts for storage, bonding curves, trade execution, treasury management, creator fees, and interoperability. Instead of forcing projects into a single-chain launch model, Printr centers the token experience and hides much of the cross-chain complexity from creators and traders. On Mantle, Printr can be used by projects that want to launch tokens, build early liquidity, and connect communities across ecosystems.
